source.notes: Scanned school examination paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Header printed: 'Grade - VIII', 'SCHOOL' (placeholder, no school name), 'Mathematics', 'Time : 2 hrs 30 min.', 'ASSESSMENT - I', 'MM - 35'. No year is printed; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name (...-150323-2023) and the icseboard.org folder. Marks come from the section headings: Section A 'each question carry 1 mark' (Q.1 i-x), Section B 'Each carry 2 marks' (Attempt any 5 of Q.2-Q.7), Section C 'Each question carry 3 marks' (Attempt any 5 of Q.8-Q.14); listed marks therefore add up to 43 against MM 35. Multi-part questions (Q.3, Q.10, Q.13) are kept whole because only the question mark is stated. Fractions, powers and roots were rebuilt inline from the page images and flagged. Handwritten ticks, marks and working on the scan were ignored; the Whatsapp/Paytm advert at the end of page 4 is page furniture. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
In an examination, Preeti scored 60 out of 75 in science, 84 out of 100 in mathematics, 36 out of 50 in Hindi and 30 out of 45 in English.
i) In which subject her performance is worst ?
ii) In which subject her performance is the best ?
Manoj sells two watches for Rs. 5865 each, gaining 15% on the one and losing 15% on the other . Find his gain or loss per cent on the whole transaction.
Construct a Δ XYZ such that XY = 3.5 cm and angle X = angle Y = 65°. Draw the lines of symmetry for this triangle.

a) 4096 plants are to be planted in a garden in such a way that each row contains as many plants as the number of rows. Find the number of rows and the number of plants in each row.
b) Find 10 rational numbers between (-3)/4 and 5/6.
